sources.title: [2603.25640] RenoBench: A Citation Parsing Benchmark - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Starting from 161,000 annotated citations, we apply automated validation and feature-based sampling to produce a dataset of 10,000 citations spanning multiple languages, publication types, and platforms. We then evaluate a variety of citation parsing systems and report field-level precision and recall.
